CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to any identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (color positions), an explicit presentation/organization mapping, and separate origin/status metadata are all provided for the same p0/current/n0 referent.

A.rationale: No text links an attention/allocation condition or change to how a specific identified content is presented or accessed.

C.rationale: Report explicitly names contents (red, blue) together with their coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata are recorded separately from the color/position entries, distinguishing content identity from provenance/status.

O.rationale: The text specifies how coordinates map to the grid and groups color positions into named nodes/candidates, i.e. how content is organized/presented.
